items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Everybody said, wow, this cat’s – first thing they did was associate him with Charlie Parker, because he played that style. But he was more funky than Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: What did he play? Do you recall . . .?

He played at Cafe Bohemia. He played there. There he was sitting in for my wife’s ex- boyfriend, Jerome Richardson. He was sitting in for Jerome. Everybody heard him then for the first time. Everybody said, wow, this cat’s – first thing they did was associate him with Charlie Parker, because he played that style. But he was more funky than Charlie Parker. He was just down to earth.
